jobs.name: A / Sunshine Mix
jobs.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing.
Game: Blend Trails: Color Puzzle. An existing casual puzzle where players trace two independent colored paths through square tiles using only horizontal and vertical steps. Tiles and shared path segments occupied by both colors show the mixed color. Red + blue = purple, red + yellow = orange, blue + yellow = green. A stage uses ONLY ONE of these two-color palettes, never all three primary colors simultaneously.
Input image 1: REFERENCE ONLY for the current approved brand and illustration style, not an edit target. Input image 2: REFERENCE ONLY for actual square tiles and thick navy outlines. Create a NEW standalone store marketing asset.
Visual style: the approved 2D Toon Bold visual identity, bright clear sky blue #28B3E8, warm cream #FFF6D9, dark ink navy #061843, coral red #FF343E, sunny yellow #FFD21A, rich cobalt #006BFF, purple #8B29F5, orange #FF8B08, green #3BC565. Very bold rounded silhouettes, crisp dark navy keylines, clean flat cel shading, small painted highlights on colored paths, restrained flat offset cyan/navy shadow within artwork. Polished friendly US casual puzzle aesthetic, high contrast and readable when tiny. Keep it recognizably a simple 2D game, not a realistic 3D render.
All path bends are rounded 90-degree corners, no diagonals, no knots. Circular start markers, square rounded game tiles. Only the overlap becomes the correct mixed color. The shared segment is one combined mixed-color stroke.
Avoid other games' characters, crowns, mascots, gems, coins, hands, fingers, phone frames, download badges, ratings, ranking claims, price claims, watermarks, UI buttons, stage selectors, reset controls, comparison sheets. A single finished asset per image.
Asset type: app icon, full-bleed square 1024 x 1024. Full opaque square background, no pre-rounded outside corners or border around image.
Primary request: the approved title's red + yellow = orange motif enlarged into an exceptionally strong app icon. Three chunky cream rounded square tiles tightly arranged as a broad inverted triangle: upper-left red start tile, upper-right yellow start tile, lower-center orange mix tile. A thick red route from a large red circle bends right then down toward the lower center; a yellow route from a large yellow circle bends left then down. Their common central segment is visibly orange and finishes in a large orange circle inside the lower tile. Match reference 1's iconic motif faithfully but use a tighter icon-specific arrangement.
Composition: centered compact emblem fills about 80 percent of the square, 9 percent safe margins. Vivid sky-blue background with just two very subtle pale-cyan cloud fragments near outer corners. Cream tiles, thick navy rim, red/yellow/orange create the focal point. Three small cream celebratory ticks around orange tile, no star confetti. Minimal detail.
Text: absolutely no text or letters.
